method: Ran atomscan and cleave facts for each original before editing; reran atomscan and local-trait JSON analysis after editing.
Parsed PE structures with pefile; disassembled loader execution paths with rizin; extracted and independently inspected embedded DLL bytes. No specimen executed.
All three share identical 6298-byte live .text content. Triage pages could not be retrieved; verdict does not rely on sandbox scores, ML labels, filenames, or family strings alone.

samples.resource_status: Entire declared resource span is zero-filled; no recoverable payload.

DLL/101/2052 embeds the same 39936-byte PE, SHA256 0df2765cead245e3a89f9fafbbe5eb42ec7d41386a6c6dc235827539171335fd; 94.49 percent zero bytes, no executable section, erased import/export/code regions.

DLL/101/2052 embeds the same 39936-byte PE, SHA256 0df2765cead245e3a89f9fafbbe5eb42ec7d41386a6c6dc235827539171335fd; 94.49 percent zero bytes, no executable section, erased import/export/code regions.

execution_evidence.claim: CRT entry calls WinMain. Configuration at RVA 0x4120 is 3 in all three; WinMain takes the branch at 0x1f75 and calls 0x1900, then 0x1390.

CoCreateGuid and snprintf form a GUID. Code builds a Windows-directory GUID.exe path and an HKLM Active Setup Installed Components GUID key; RegSetValueExA at 0x1a4b writes StubPath (REG_EXPAND_SZ) with the executable path.

Obtains its module path, reads the image with fopen/fseek/ftell/fread, patches image offsets 0x6a0 and 0x3058, saves a copy with fopen/fwrite, and supplies that copy path to CreateProcessA. Hardcoded patch offsets are retained from the original loader and do not correctly target the mode field in these memory-layout images; successful relaunch in mode 4 is not established.

GetModuleFileNameA -> GetShortPathNameA; reads COMSPEC; constructs /c del <own-short-path> > nul; CreateProcessA with flags 0x0c and ResumeThread. This is self-delete code, not ordinary unrelated file deletion.

Alternate mode-1 path constructs %SystemRoot%\System32\StormServer.dll, opens HKLM SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\LanmanServer\Parameters, deletes ServiceDLL, and replaces it with REG_EXPAND_SZ through RegSetValueExA at 0x133e. This branch is present but mode 3 is selected in these files.

Mode-4 code requests resource DLL/101, copies resource bytes, and passes them to CreateFileA/WriteFile. Injection code creates a configured iexplore/notepad/calc child, allocates remote memory, writes the DLL path, resolves LoadLibraryA, and passes that export as the CreateRemoteThread entry with the remote path as its argument. Erased resources or code prevent proof of successful payload activation.

limitations: The embedded DLLs retain Storm ddos DNS and STORM command-format strings but no recoverable working networking or attack implementation; no DDoS, theft, ransomware, or Remcos capability is inferred.
GUID strings overwrite portions of the saved IAT, which contains resolved process-specific addresses. Treat these as damaged/memory-layout specimens, not a demonstrated working installation.

cleave facts emits a URL-decoded observation for the GUID snprintf format string (%08X etc.). This is heuristic interpretation of a format string, not runtime URL decoding or obfuscation; the engine-emitted observation cannot be repaired by a YAML shadow rule.
trait_changes: Description-only corrections distinguish static code and API co-occurrence from completed operations and distinguish a literal environment-variable path from expansion. Matchers, severity, taxonomy locations and coverage remain unchanged; no additional unsupported behavioral rules are warranted.
